title: fix(worktree): remap host ports Docker Desktop cannot publish on WSL
description: Stops ngramx worktree / nwt failing on Docker Desktop + WSL when a compose port plus offset lands in a Windows Hyper-V excluded range. Those ports are remapped before compose-up, and a /forwards/expose 500 retries once with a replacement.

test_plan.description: A Hydra worktree no longer dies on the 56306 + offset publish
steps: On Docker Desktop + WSL, confirm Windows has reserved the high band: netsh.exe interface ipv4 show excludedportrange protocol=tcp
From hydra-main, run nwt gig-3816 (or ngramx worktree <ticket>) with this ngramx build
Expect ngramx to report that 64506 (or whichever 56306+offset port) cannot be published and to use a port below 49152 instead
Expect the app container to start; docker ps should show the remapped host port, not a /forwards/expose 500

test_plan.description: A publish 500 that slips past the pre-check is remapped and retried
steps: If compose still prints 'ports are not available' / '/forwards/expose returned unexpected status: 500' for one host port
Expect ngramx to warn that the port was remapped, regenerate the override, and retry compose-up once
Expect the stack to come up on the replacement port

test_plan.description: Unrelated compose failures are not swallowed
steps: Force a non-publish start failure (for example a missing image or a stale bind-mount path ngramx cannot recover)
Expect the original error to surface — no host-port remap messaging
